evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies the mining IPC interface methods waitTipChanged and waitNext.
rationale: Clamping negative and NaN timeouts hardens the mining IPC interface against malformed client inputs that cause debug node crashes via Assume assertion failures or unexpected delays in wait_until. The author notes no known client currently exhibits this behavior ('sv2-tp, for example, requires an interval of at least one second'), making it a worthwhile but deferrable robustness fix.
